test_BVH_from_file: test the BVH class by loading a zombie.bvh file and validating skeleton, frame time, and frame count
test_BVH_joint_count: test that the BVH root joint count equals 34 after loading a BVH motion capture file
test_BVH_frame_time: test that the BVH frame time parses correctly as 0.0333333 seconds per frame
test_BVH_position_data: test that the BVH position data shape matches frame count with XYZ coordinates per frame
test_BVH_rotation_data: test that the BVH rotation data contains quaternion rotations for every joint in every frame
